attributes.action: Fireworks Should Be for Organised Events Only – Protect Animals and Communities.
attributes.additional_details: We are calling for a ban on household fireworks, restricting their use to organised public events operated by fully trained professionals. Loud explosions cause fear, stress and sometimes injury or death to pets, livestock and wildlife. Fireworks also create serious fire risks, injuries, property damage and distress for elderly, disabled and vulnerable people. Celebrations should not come at the expense of animal welfare and public safety.
attributes.background: Ban household fireworks and restrict displays to organised events run by fully trained professionals. Fireworks cause unnecessary suffering to pets and create fire risks, cause injuries and distress families and vulnerable people. Protect animals, people and homes. Celebrate safely and responsibly.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
